top_signals.title: Franc, Yen Emerge as FX Winners as US Midterms Weaken Dollar
top_signals.summary: The Swiss franc and Japanese yen jumped as early US election results pointed to the Democrats winning both the House and the Senate, sending the dollar to its worst day in a month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Japan Courrier Service Yamato’s Shares Surge on Farallon Stake
top_signals.summary: Yamato Holdings Co. shares rallied the most in 18 years after Farallon Capital Management LLC, one of the most prolific activist funds in Japan, reported a stake in the Japanese company and called for a management shakeup.

top_signals.title: Global Solar Stocks Jump as Democrats Hold Early US Midterm Lead
top_signals.summary: Global solar stocks rallied as investors priced in growing odds of a Democratic sweep of Congress in the US midterm elections, an outcome seen supporting the renewable energy sector.
